name: evtx_carve
description: Recover event records from a blob with no event log file: sweeps for ElfChnk chunk headers in unallocated space, a pagefile, a memory image or a truncated .evtx, verifies each chunk's checksums and parses the records inside it. This is how a cleared log is read.

path.description: A raw blob: unallocated output, pagefile.sys, a memory image, or a damaged .evtx

contains.description: Keep only records whose XML contains this string, case-insensitive

start.description: Byte offset to start the sweep at (default 0)

max_bytes.description: Stop the sweep after this many bytes

chunk_limit.description: Chunks to parse in one call (default 200). When more remain the sweep stops before the next chunk and resume_start names the offset to pass as start; nothing before it is skipped

limit.description: Records shown inline (default 300); every matching record is kept, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results
